summary.text: Karlie Easley is the Democratic candidate for Idaho State Senate District 22 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her career experience includes working as a nurse.

paragraphs.text: In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Karlie Easley described herself as a hospice nurse, a mother and a fourth-generation Idahoan who was raised in eastern Idaho and the Treasure Valley and lives in District 22 with her wife and their son.
She said her priorities include accessible and affordable healthcare, school funding and teacher support, and affordability issues such as housing.
